atlas: VEP, 162 nonzero labels, verified exact connectome label order for development sub-003 and sub-010

subjects_used.sub-010: reserved development subject; structural donor control only

connectome.meaning: patient-derived structural weights; rows targets, columns sources in TVB

gain.meaning: monopolar inverse-square forward gain, contacts by atlas regions

gain.unit: unverified model-to-sensor scale; no physical conductivity calibration established
gain.verification: 185 bipolar names matched, 162 columns; released source projection residual remains unresolved

sensor_recording.caveat: synthetic export amplitude and physical time scaling are not independently validated

source_recording.status: simulated x2 minus x1; development reconstruction reference only
